## What's new

- Added an "Invert placement list order" experimental setting which changes the visual order for it from Last-First to First-Last
- Updated UNANIMATED integration (v0.1.27)
  - Added or updated Countdown, Character, Visual and Background Video-related event groups, with their new actions
  - Made Ctrl+A work correctly when inputting text
- Added a "File > Open backups folder..." option, and improved the guide text file.
- Deleting snippets now requires two clicks to confirm deletion
- Snippets now have a small color hint on whether they are saved by beats or time.
- Made the placement order list not scroll unnecessarily
- Timing points are now semi-tracked in the undo history (experimental)

**Happy mapping!**
